subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
title: Relationships within the Family
overview: Healthy family relationships keep children safe and teach them to respect one another. In this sub-strand you will learn to be careful when you are alone with someone, how to protect yourself from sexual abuse, and whom to tell if anyone touches you in a bad way. You will read 1 Corinthians 6:19 and 2 Samuel 13:4-14 and treat your body as the temple of the Holy Spirit.

lessons.title: Being careful when you are alone
objectives: Tell the story of Tamar and Amnon in 2 Samuel 13:4-14 in a safe, simple way.
State how to take care when alone with people of the opposite sex.
lessons.intro: Most family members love and protect children. The Bible also tells a sad story of a brother who used a trick and would not listen when a girl said no. That story teaches you to be careful.
lessons.notes:
### The story in 2 Samuel 13:4-14
Amnon was a son of King David. He told his friend Jonadab that he wanted Tamar, the sister of Absalom, in a wrong way. Jonadab told him to pretend to be ill and to ask the king to send Tamar to prepare food for him. King David sent Tamar to Amnon's house.

Tamar made the food. Amnon refused to eat it while other people were there and sent them out. He told Tamar to bring the food into his bedroom. Then he took hold of her and asked her to lie with him.

Tamar said no. She told him not to force her. She said such a thing was wicked in Israel, and she asked him to speak to the king instead of doing this shameful act. Amnon would not listen to her. He was stronger than she was, and he forced her. That was sexual abuse. The wrong belonged to Amnon, not to Tamar. She had said no.

### What the story teaches
- Do not go into a closed room alone with someone who wants you there for a wrong reason.
- A relative can do wrong. Being in the family does not make a bad touch acceptable.
- Saying no is the right action, even if the other person is older or stronger.
- Pretending to be sick, or sending everyone else away, can be a trick. Notice it and leave.

### Taking care with the opposite sex
Boys and girls can be friends, classmates and family. Take care when you are alone together. Stay where other people can see you. Do not lie on a bed with someone. Do not play games that involve undressing or secret touching. If a person of the opposite sex asks you to keep a meeting secret from your parents, do not go. Healthy families do not ask children to hide wrong actions.

keyWords.meaning: a boy in relation to a girl, or a girl in relation to a boy
forcing or tricking someone into sexual touching or a sexual act

activity.title: Read 2 Samuel 13:4-14 in turns
steps: In turns, read 2 Samuel 13:4-14. The teacher guides the reading so that it stays respectful.
As a class, retell only what the verses say: the trick, Tamar's refusal, and Amnon's refusal to listen.
List two ways to take care when you are alone with a person of the opposite sex.
Sing a song about respecting your body.

practice.question: How did Amnon get Tamar to come to him?
practice.answer: He pretended to be ill, and King David sent Tamar to prepare food for him.

practice.question: What did Tamar say when Amnon wanted to lie with her?
practice.answer: She said no, told him not to force her, and said the act was wicked.

practice.question: Give two ways to take care when you are alone with a person of the opposite sex.
practice.answer: Any two: stay where others can see you; do not go into a closed bedroom; do not keep secret meetings; leave if everyone else is sent out; say no to bad touching.

summary: Amnon tricked Tamar into a room alone and refused to listen when she said no.
The wrong was his. Saying no was right.
Stay where others can see you, and do not keep secret meetings.

lessons.title: Protecting yourself from sexual abuse
objectives: Mention ways of protecting oneself from sexual abuse.
Say no firmly to gifts or touches that are wrong.
lessons.intro: Your body belongs to you, and it belongs to God. Nobody is allowed to touch the private parts of your body or to ask you for sexual acts. You can learn ways to protect yourself.
lessons.notes:
Sexual abuse is any sexual touching or sexual act that is forced, tricked or done to a child. A child cannot agree to it. It is always wrong, whether the person is a stranger, a neighbour, a worker at school, or a member of the family.

### Ways to protect yourself
- Say "No!" in a strong voice.
- Move away at once to a place with other people.
- Do not accept gifts, money, sweets or lifts from someone who wants a secret in return.
- Do not go to lonely places with anyone who makes you uneasy.
- Walk to school and back with other learners when you can.
- Do not watch or share bad pictures.
- Tell a parent or teacher if someone's words or touches make you uncomfortable.
- Refuse to keep a bad secret. A good secret is a surprise gift. A bad secret hides harm.

### Gifts that are traps
Some people tempt children with gifts and then ask for wrong touching. You may like the gift and still say no. In a role-play, one learner offers a gift and says, "Do not tell anyone." The other learner says, "No! I will tell my parent." Then the learner walks away. Practise until the word No feels strong.

### Your body is not the problem
Wearing a school uniform, being friendly, or being alone does not cause abuse. The person who touches wrongly is the one who sins. Protecting yourself is wisdom. It is the same wisdom Tamar showed when she refused, even though Amnon did not stop. You add another step she needed: run to a trusted adult as fast as you can.

keyWords.meaning: to keep yourself safe from harm
a secret that hides harm and should be told to a trusted adult
the parts of the body covered by underwear, which others must not touch

activity.title: Role-play saying NO
steps: In groups, tell how you should protect yourselves from sexual abuse.
Role-play a child being tempted with a gift by someone who wants a secret. The child says NO and walks away.
Watch, if the teacher provides it, a video clip of children who are tempted with gifts but say NO to strangers.
Write two protection rules in your exercise book.

practice.question: What is sexual abuse?
practice.answer: Forcing, tricking or involving a child in sexual touching or a sexual act. It is always wrong.

practice.question: List three ways to protect yourself from sexual abuse.
practice.answer: Any three: say No, move to where people are, refuse gifts that come with secrets, avoid lonely places, walk with friends, do not keep bad secrets, tell a trusted adult.

practice.question: Why should you refuse a gift that comes with the words "Do not tell anyone"?
practice.answer: That kind of gift can be a trap leading to harm. A bad secret should be told to a trusted adult.

summary: Sexual abuse is always wrong, even if the person is a relative.
Say No, move away, refuse secret gifts, and do not keep bad secrets.
The person who does the wrong touching is the one who sins.

lessons.title: Whom to tell, and the body as God's temple
objectives: Identify whom to report to if touched inappropriately or sexually abused.
Explain 1 Corinthians 6:19 and choose to live a holy life.
lessons.intro: If someone touches you in a way that feels wrong, you need a person who will believe you and help you. God also calls your body His temple. That is a reason to live a holy life.
lessons.notes:
### Whom to report to
If you are touched inappropriately or sexually abused, tell a person who can protect you:

- A parent or guardian
- A grandparent you trust
- Your class teacher or the head teacher
- A church leader or Sunday school teacher
- A police officer
- Another adult your parents have told you is safe

If the first person does not help, tell a second person. Keep telling until someone acts. In Kenya, a child can also call Childline Kenya on 116, free of charge. You can call the police on 999 or 112.

Report even if the person is a relative, even if you accepted a gift, and even if you were told to keep it secret. You will not be in trouble for telling. The abuse is not your fault.

### 1 Corinthians 6:19
The verse says that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, and that you are not your own. A temple is a holy place where God is honoured. Write this verse on a flash card and meditate on it. Meditate means to think about it quietly and let it shape you.

### Living a holy life
Because the Holy Spirit dwells in Christians, we keep our bodies for God's honour.

- We say no to sexual sin and to sex before marriage.
- We dress neatly and respect other people's bodies.
- We do not use our bodies to harm or to shame anyone.
- We pray and ask God for strength to stay pure.

Appreciating the body as God's temple means thanking Him for it and refusing to let anyone treat it as a toy. Sing a song about respecting your body as the temple of the Holy Spirit.

keyWords.meaning: to tell a responsible person what happened
the believer's body, where the Holy Spirit lives
set apart for God and kept pure

activity.title: Flash cards and people we report to
steps: Each learner says whom he or she would report to if touched inappropriately.
Write 1 Corinthians 6:19 on a flash card and read it slowly, then sit quietly and think about it.
In groups, list ways to live a holy life.
Sing a song about the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit.

practice.question: Name three people you can report to if someone touches you inappropriately.
practice.answer: Any three: a parent or guardian, a trusted grandparent, a teacher, a church leader, a police officer.

practice.question: What number can a child in Kenya call free of charge for help?
What does 1 Corinthians 6:19 say about the body of a Christian?
practice.answer: It is a temple of the Holy Spirit, and we are not our own.

summary: Report bad touching to a parent, teacher, church leader or the police, and keep telling until you get help.
1 Corinthians 6:19: your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit, so live a holy life.

quiz.question: In 2 Samuel 13, how did Amnon arrange for Tamar to come to him?
options: He met her at the market
He pretended to be ill so she would be sent to prepare food
He wrote her a letter from another country
He asked her in front of the whole town
quiz.explanation: Jonadab's plan was that Amnon should pretend to be ill and ask for Tamar to bring food.

quiz.question: What did Tamar do when Amnon asked her to lie with him?
options: She agreed at once
She said no and told him not to force her
She called for a celebration
She left the country before he spoke
quiz.explanation: Tamar refused and said the act was wicked. Amnon would not listen.

quiz.question: Which action helps you take care when you are with a person of the opposite sex?
options: Going into a closed bedroom alone
Keeping the meeting secret from parents
Staying where other people can see you
Sending everyone else out of the room
quiz.explanation: Staying in view of other people is a way of taking care.

quiz.question: Sexual abuse is...
options: sometimes acceptable if the person is a relative
always wrong
the child's fault
a game children should keep secret
quiz.explanation: Sexual abuse is always wrong, and the blame belongs to the person who does it.

quiz.question: Which of these protects you from sexual abuse?
options: Accepting secret gifts
Saying No and moving to where people are
Keeping a bad secret
Going to a lonely place
quiz.explanation: A firm No and moving to other people are ways of protection.

quiz.question: A bad secret is a secret that...
quiz.answer: hides harm and should be told to a trusted adult.
quiz.explanation: Surprise gifts can be good secrets. Secrets about bad touching are not.

quiz.question: If someone touches you inappropriately, you should first...
options: keep quiet forever
tell a trusted adult such as a parent or teacher
blame yourself
hide from every adult
quiz.explanation: Reporting to a responsible person brings help.

quiz.question: Which number is Childline Kenya?
options: 911 only
quiz.explanation: Children in Kenya can call 116 free of charge.

quiz.question: 1 Corinthians 6:19 teaches that a Christian's body is...
options: of no value
a temple of the Holy Spirit
belonging only to friends
something to hide in shame
quiz.explanation: The verse says the body is a temple of the Holy Spirit and that we are not our own.

quiz.question: How can a learner live a holy life?
quiz.answer: By saying no to sexual sin, respecting his or her body and other people's bodies, and asking God for help to stay pure.
quiz.explanation: Holiness means being set apart for God, including keeping the body pure.
